sources.title: ラインを読む｜競輪ガイド
sources.exact_evidence_location: Body explains that riders cooperate in lines, line formation is fundamental to race development, basic composition is self-powered leader followed by pursuit riders, and describes 2/3/4-line patterns, 番手, block, gap opening, switching and competition for position.

sources.title: KEIRIN official app service notices 2012-2013
sources.exact_evidence_location: Official app notices describe 並び予想情報 as prediction information and a prediction-support content item, not as an objective declared race state.

sources.title: 競輪場/場外売場｜競輪場分析
sources.exact_evidence_location: Current body section バンク基礎データ exposes fields 周長, みなし直線距離, センター部路面傾斜, 直線部分路面傾斜, ホーム幅員, バック幅員, センター幅員, plus record data. Values were not present in retrieved text because the service renders/fetches them dynamically.

sources.title: DMM競輪では、チャリロトの対象となっているレースで、2人の選手が1着になった場合はどのようになりますか？
sources.exact_evidence_location: Body explains a ChariLoto dead-heat example producing two winning sequences and reproduces the payout formula identified as 自転車競技法施行規則 付録第2. It is secondary support evidence and must not outrank current law/JKA regulation.

sources.title: 出走表を見る｜競輪ガイド
sources.exact_evidence_location: Body defines style 逃/両/追, recent-four-month competition score, historical finishing methods 逃/捲/差/マ, B, H, S, recent-four-month win/2-place/3-place rates, recent race stage/result notation including 欠/落/棄/失/補, and explicitly separates prediction marks as journalist predictions.

sources.title: 競輪に係る業務の方法に関する規程 付録第1 競走得点及び評価点算定の方法
sources.exact_evidence_location: Current body defines per-race competition-point calculation, exclusions such as DQ/abandonment/non-established races, average competition-score calculation and evaluation-score penalties. No explicit current body isolated in this audit equates the public racecard recent-four-month displayed score to a specific regulatory averaging/version publication contract.

reality_classification_updates.note: Official KEIRIN.JP guide explicitly describes line cooperation and roles.
No objective timing-safe official per-race declaration was verified; historical official services explicitly label narabi as prediction information.
Current official venue-analysis interface exposes the physical-field schema, but numeric extraction/versioning remains unresolved.
Official racecard guide defines H; current audited v3 parser/S0 does not use H.
